    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`Sometimes you need to add extra logic to an existing controller method without completely replacing it. This approach allows you to extend the out-of-the-box functionality by subscribing to the same event and adding your custom processing alongside the original method.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Adding logging to track method execution`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Performing additional validation before/after an action`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Triggering side effects when certain events occur`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Extending functionality without modifying core controllers`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Prerequisites:`}</strong></p>

          "href": "/configuration-practices-documentation/overview#appcustomizationsjs-template"

    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Important Note:`}</strong></p>
    <blockquote>
      <p parentName="blockquote">{`⚠️ The execution order of methods with the same name cannot be guaranteed. All methods subscribed to an event are called, but the sequence is not enforced by the platform. If order matters, use `}<a parentName="p" {...{

        "className": "language-js"

 * Custom Application Logic
 */
const TAG = 'CustomWorkLog';

class AppCustomizations {
    /**
     * Initialize application
     * @param {Application} app - The application instance
     */
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    /**
     * Additional logic for closeWorkLogSaveDiscard
     * This runs in parallel with the out-of-the-box method
     */
    closeWorkLogSaveDiscard() {
        // Add your custom logic here
        this.app.log.d(TAG, 'Intercepting closeWorkLogSaveDiscard');
        
        // Example: Track user actions
        this.trackUserAction('worklog_discarded');
        
        // Example: Clear custom state
        if (this.app.currentPage) {
            this.app.currentPage.state.customWorkLogData = null;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Helper method to track user actions
     * @param {string} action - The action name
     */
    trackUserAction(action) {
        this.app.log.i(TAG, \`User action: \${action}\`);
        // Add analytics or logging here
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>

    <h2>{`Complete Examples`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Example 1: Adding Validation to Save Action`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const TAG = 'CustomValidation';

class AppCustomizations {
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    /**
     * Add custom validation when saving work order
     * Runs alongside the out-of-the-box save logic
     */
    async saveWorkOrder() {
        this.app.log.d(TAG, 'Running custom save validation');
        
        const woDS = this.app.findDatasource('woDetailResource');
        if (!woDS || !woDS.item) {
            this.app.log.e(TAG, 'No work order to validate');
            return;
        }
        
        const workOrder = woDS.item;
        
        // Custom validation: Check if high priority work orders have notes
        if (workOrder.wopriority === 1 && !workOrder.description_longdescription) {
            this.app.toast(
                'High priority work orders should include detailed notes',
                'warning'
            );
        }
        
        // Log the save action
        this.app.log.i(TAG, \`Saving work order: \${workOrder.wonum}\`);
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 2: Tracking Page Navigation`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const TAG = 'NavigationTracker';

class AppCustomizations {
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
        this.navigationHistory = [];
    }
    
    /**
     * Track when user navigates to work order details
     * Extends the out-of-the-box navigation logic
     */
    navigateToWorkOrderDetails(event) {
        const wonum = event?.item?.wonum || 'unknown';
        
        this.app.log.d(TAG, \`Navigating to work order: \${wonum}\`);
        
        // Track navigation history
        this.navigationHistory.push({
            page: 'workOrderDetails',
            wonum: wonum,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        });
        
        // Keep only last 10 navigations
        if (this.navigationHistory.length > 10) {
            this.navigationHistory.shift();
        }
        
        // Log navigation pattern
        this.app.log.d(TAG, \`Navigation history: \${this.navigationHistory.length} items\`);
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 3: Adding Logging to Multiple Events`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const TAG = 'EventLogger';

class AppCustomizations {
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    /**
     * Log when datasource loads data
     * @param {Datasource} datasource - The datasource
     * @param {Array} items - Loaded items
     * @param {Object} query - Query parameters
     */
    onAfterLoadData(datasource, items, query) {
        this.app.log.d(TAG, \`Datasource \${datasource.name} loaded \${items.length} items\`);
        
        // Track load performance
        if (items.length > 100) {
            this.app.log.w(TAG, \`Large dataset loaded: \${items.length} items\`);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Log when field values change
     * @param {Object} event - Value change event
     */
    onValueChanged(event) {
        const {datasource, field, oldValue, newValue} = event;
        
        this.app.log.d(TAG, 
            \`Field changed in \${datasource.name}: \${field} from "\${oldValue}" to "\${newValue}"\`
        );
        
        // Track specific field changes
        if (field === 'status') {
            this.app.log.i(TAG, \`Status changed to: \${newValue}\`);
        }
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
